@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion)),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates the Flipt trace provider, including environment resource attributes.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(res),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for the supplied configuration and returns its cleanup function.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing config is nil")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exp tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		endpoint := cfg.OTLP.Endpoint
+		if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
+			endpoint = "grpc://" + endpoint
+		}
+		u, parseErr := url.Parse(endpoint)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", parseErr)
+		}
+		if u.Host == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid endpoint %q", cfg.OTLP.Endpoint)
+		}
+
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		switch u.Scheme {
+		case "http", "https":
+			opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+				otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+			}
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+			}
+			if u.Scheme == "http" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+			}
+			client = otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...)
+		case "grpc":
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unexpected path %q", u.Path)
+			}
+			if _, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(u.Host); splitErr != nil {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", splitErr)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		default:
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported scheme %q", u.Scheme)
+		}
+		exp, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return exp, exp.Shutdown, nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,133 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs := res.Set()
+	serviceName, ok := attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "flipt", serviceName.AsString())
+	version, ok := attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "1.2.3", version.AsString())
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "from-service-name")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "service.name=from-resource,service.version=from-resource,region=test")
+	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), "4.5.6")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs = res.Set()
+	serviceName, ok = attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "from-service-name", serviceName.AsString())
+	version, ok = attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "4.5.6", version.AsString())
+	region, ok := attrs.Value(attribute.Key("region"))
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "test", region.AsString())
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	assert.True(t, span.SpanContext().IsSampled())
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"Jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"Zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTP", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4318", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTPS", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4318", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP GRPC", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP default", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tt.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.NotNil(t, exp)
+			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
+			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background())) })
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetExporterIndependentCalls(t *testing.T) {
+	bad := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), bad)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unsupported tracing exporter: 99"))
+
+	good := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}
+	first, firstShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	second, secondShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.NotSame(t, first, second)
+	require.NoError(t, firstShutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, secondShutdown(context.Background()))
+}
+
+func TestGetExporterInvalidEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, endpoint := range []string{"http://%", "localhost", "ftp://localhost:4317", "grpc://localhost:4317/path"} {
+		t.Run(endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
+			cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
+			_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+			require.Error(t, err)
+			assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "parsing otlp endpoint:")
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestOTLPHTTPHeadersAndPath(t *testing.T) {
+	requests := make(chan *http.Request, 1)
+	collector := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(collector.Close)
+
+	cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+		Endpoint: collector.URL + "/custom/traces",
+		Headers:  map[string]string{"X-Test-Header": "configured"},
+	}}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSpanProcessor(tracesdk.NewSimpleSpanProcessor(exp)))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "export")
+	span.End()
+	require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+
+	select {
+	case request := <-requests:
+		assert.Equal(t, "/custom/traces", request.URL.Path)
+		assert.Equal(t, "configured", request.Header.Get("X-Test-Header"))
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("collector received no trace")
+	}
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion)),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates the Flipt trace provider, including environment resource attributes.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(res),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for the supplied configuration and returns its cleanup function.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing config is nil")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exp tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		endpoint := cfg.OTLP.Endpoint
+		if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
+			endpoint = "grpc://" + endpoint
+		}
+		u, parseErr := url.Parse(endpoint)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", parseErr)
+		}
+		if u.Host == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid endpoint %q", cfg.OTLP.Endpoint)
+		}
+
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		switch u.Scheme {
+		case "http", "https":
+			opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+				otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+			}
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+			}
+			if u.Scheme == "http" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+			}
+			client = otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...)
+		case "grpc":
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unexpected path %q", u.Path)
+			}
+			if _, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(u.Host); splitErr != nil {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", splitErr)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		default:
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported scheme %q", u.Scheme)
+		}
+		exp, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return exp, exp.Shutdown, nil
+}

+package tracing

+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs := res.Set()
+	serviceName, ok := attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "flipt", serviceName.AsString())
+	version, ok := attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "1.2.3", version.AsString())
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "from-service-name")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "service.name=from-resource,service.version=from-resource,region=test")
+	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), "4.5.6")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs = res.Set()
+	serviceName, ok = attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "from-service-name", serviceName.AsString())
+	version, ok = attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "4.5.6", version.AsString())
+	region, ok := attrs.Value(attribute.Key("region"))
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	assert.Equal(t, "test", region.AsString())
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	assert.True(t, span.SpanContext().IsSampled())
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"Jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"Zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTP", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4318", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTPS", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4318", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP GRPC", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP default", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tt.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.NotNil(t, exp)
+			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
+			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background())) })
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetExporterIndependentCalls(t *testing.T) {
+	bad := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), bad)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unsupported tracing exporter: 99"))
+
+	good := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}
+	first, firstShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	second, secondShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.NotSame(t, first, second)
+	require.NoError(t, firstShutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, secondShutdown(context.Background()))
+}
+
+func TestGetExporterInvalidEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, endpoint := range []string{"http://%", "localhost", "ftp://localhost:4317", "grpc://localhost:4317/path"} {
+		t.Run(endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
+			cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
+			_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+			require.Error(t, err)
+			assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "parsing otlp endpoint:")
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestOTLPHTTPHeadersAndPath(t *testing.T) {
+	requests := make(chan *http.Request, 1)
+	collector := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(collector.Close)
+
+	cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+		Endpoint: collector.URL + "/custom/traces",
+		Headers:  map[string]string{"X-Test-Header": "configured"},
+	}}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSpanProcessor(tracesdk.NewSimpleSpanProcessor(exp)))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "export")
+	span.End()
+	require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+
+	select {
+	case request := <-requests:
+		assert.Equal(t, "/custom/traces", request.URL.Path)
+		assert.Equal(t, "configured", request.Header.Get("X-Test-Header"))
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("collector received no trace")
+	}
+}
